title: Character phoneticName lives in extensions, not a top-level column
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:63-64 '// phoneticName lives as a top-level character/persona column (not in extensions): phoneticName: string, // ... edited in the Voice tab (v2.5.0)'; :128 '`phoneticName` (top-level column, `phonetic_name`; part of the card, so it needs Save)'
reality: For characters it is `data.extensions.phoneticName`: packages/shared/src/types/character.ts:78-79 (CharacterExtensions.phoneticName); client/src/components/characters/CharacterEditor.tsx:5572,5600 (Voice tab reads formData.extensions.phoneticName, writes updateExtension('phoneticName')); server/src/services/prompt/macro-context.ts:250,731 read data.extensions.phoneticName. The characters table stores only a `data` JSON blob (server/src/db/schema/characters.ts:6-18). The `phonetic_name` column exists only on the personas table (characters.ts:58), and the persona's Phonetic name is edited on the persona Metadata tab (PersonaEditor.tsx:3662, en.json ui.personas.personametadatatab.phoneticName). The persona editor has no Voice tab (PersonaEditor.tsx:155-163).
fix: In the schema block, move `phoneticName: string` inside `extensions` (Voice tab, v2.5.0) and delete the 'top-level ... not in extensions' comment. In the Voice section, say: characters store it as `extensions.phoneticName` (saved with the card); personas keep a top-level `phoneticName` (`phonetic_name` column) edited on the persona Metadata tab, since only the Character Editor has a Voice tab.

title: Character-ID / Persona-ID reference blocks carry more fields than listed, including Conversation-only ones
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:146 'plus its other non-empty text fields (system prompt, post-history, depth prompt, creator notes, tags, RPG attributes ...)'; :151 persona ref adds 'Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario plus eligible attached-lorebook context'; :116 Conversation profile fields 'are never sent in Roleplay / VN / Game mode'
reality: buildReferencedCharacterFields (packages/server/src/services/prompt/macro-context.ts:288-325) also sends creator, character_version, about_me (extensions.aboutMe), conversation_behavior (convoBehavior.instruction) and tracker_defaults (Tracker Custom Fields), plus the attached-lorebook block clipped at 8,000 chars (MAX_REFERENCED_LOREBOOK_CHARS, :96). This path runs in Roleplay-with-preset chats, so a referenced card's About Me and Convo Behavior DO reach the model in Roleplay. buildReferencedPersonaFields (:351-375) also sends creator, persona_version, creator_notes and about_me.
fix: Line 146: extend the list to 'creator, card version, creator notes, system prompt, post-history, depth prompt, About Me, Convo Behavior, tags, RPG attributes/pools, Tracker Custom Fields defaults' plus attached-lorebook context (8,000-char cap). Line 151: add creator, persona version, creator notes and About Me to the persona list. Line 157 caveat: add About Me / Convo Behavior and persona creator notes to the 'reaches the model' warning. Line 116: qualify 'never sent in Roleplay' with 'except inside a Character-ID reference block'.

title: Sprites -> Clips / in-call command section cites engine files and constants that moved into the Calls package
reality: Calls is an optional downloadable package (moved out in v2.3.0, CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:2290; Engine lost the call code, :2304). At v2.5.0 server/src/services/conversation/call-character-videos.service.ts is a 190-line bridge to getCapabilityService('conversation-calls:character-videos') that throws 'Calls is not installed or active' (:107-115); it has no CUSTOM_CLIP_LIMIT, and no constant of that name exists anywhere in the engine. server/src/routes/conversation-calls.routes.ts does not exist, and `custom_clip` does not occur in server/src. Current line numbers: GET /:id/gallery/clips at characters.routes.ts:1630, persona clip routes at 2746-3051; tts flags at packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:202/204/206; trim fields at conversation-call.ts:89-90/103-104; manifest at :107; clip kinds at :13-20. CALL_VIDEO_CLIP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES = 250 MB (characters.routes.ts:141).
fix: Open the section by saying Sprites -> Clips generation/upload, Character Video Presence and the in-call `[custom_clip: ...]` / `[react: ...]` commands come from the downloadable **Calls** package (Agents -> Download Agents); without it the clips manifest is empty and generation fails. Drop the `CUSTOM_CLIP_LIMIT = 128` / conversation-calls.routes.ts citations, or mark them as package-side and unverified in the Engine. Fix the remaining line refs as listed, and state the 250 MB upload cap.

title: Schema block omits several typed character extension fields
skill_evidence: references/character-cards.md:25-62 extensions block (lists talkativeness ... convoBehavior; rpgStats has only enabled/attributes/hp)
reality: packages/shared/src/types/character.ts:47-102 also types: `nameAliases` (Colors tab 'Name Aliases', extra names colored with nameColor in chat prose, en.json:4371-4374); `conversationImageInstructions` + `applyConversationImageInstructionsToNoodle` (Convo tab 'Image generation instructions' for Conversation selfies, en.json:4396-4397,4385); `conversationSchedule`, `conversationScheduleAutoRenew` (renewal is on only when === true, conversation.routes.ts:759,934) and `conversationStatusOverride` (character-owned manual presence); `trackerCustomFieldDefaults` (Stats tab 'Tracker Custom Fields', copied into each new Roleplay chat, en.json:4588-4589); `characterSheetImageId` / `useCharacterSheetAsReference`. RPGStatsConfig (:131-140) has `pools: {name,value,max,color}[]`; the editor defaults to HP and MP pools (shared/src/utils/rpg-stats.ts:3-6), and formatRpgStatsForPrompt prints pools first (:57-66).
fix: Add these keys to the extensions block, with one-line comments and the editor tab for each, and add `pools` to rpgStats. At minimum name `nameAliases`, `conversationImageInstructions`, `trackerCustomFieldDefaults`, `conversationSchedule`/`conversationScheduleAutoRenew` and `rpgStats.pools`, because they change what an author builds.

title: Template rpgStats hp 0/0 is invalid-shaped and diverges from editor default
reality: normalizeRpgStatPools clamps hp.max to at least 1 (packages/shared/src/utils/rpg-stats.ts:42-44), and the persona schema rejects max < 1 ('Maximum must be at least 1', persona.schema.ts:70-73). The Character Editor default is six attributes at 10, hp 100/100, and pools HP and MP at 100/100 (CharacterEditor.tsx:5082-5094; rpg-stats.ts:3-6).
fix: Set the template to `"hp": { "value": 100, "max": 100 }` and optionally add `"pools": [{"name":"HP","value":100,"max":100,"color":"#ef4444"}]`, or drop rpgStats from the template so the editor default applies.
